findings.message: The plan's stated 'fifty-two path-construction sites' does not reproduce. Measured non-test on the baseline: 17 resolveArtifactMdPath + 44 across TWELVE named *ArtifactPaths builders = 61, not 52; the LLD counted only seven of the twelve builders. The companion figure of 35 derivation sites DOES reproduce exactly (16 workItemKindOf + 19 workItemAnchorCreatedAt). The load-bearing claim is unaffected: 0 changed lines touch any derivation or path-construction call site, which holds at 35, 52 and 61 alike. Recorded rather than restated so the artifact's number is not treated as verified.
